before.name: Lynette Sharp
before.description: Lynette Sharp is one of the defendants charged in connection with the July 4, 2025 demonstration at the Prairieland Detention Center, an ICE jail in Alvarado, Texas, which federal prosecutors charged as a "North Texas Antifa Cell" terrorism case. Pleaded guilty on November 19, 2025 to one count of providing material support to terrorists. Testified for the government as a cooperating co-defendant during the March 2026 trial. On July 1, 2026 they were sentenced to 110 months (9 years, 2 months) in federal prison.
